paragraphs: Please consider our Original Research manuscript, “A Synthetic Study of Assessment Feedback,” for publication in the Fictional Journal of Learning Science.

Routine summaries obscure whether structured feedback improves calibration. Using a fully synthetic evaluation design, the study identifies a clearer calibration pattern while preserving appropriate uncertainty, supporting more defensible interpretation of feedback performance.
The manuscript is original, is not under consideration elsewhere, and has been approved by all authors.
empirical_anchor: Structured feedback produced a clearer calibration pattern in the synthetic evaluation.
editorial_meaning: Feedback performance can be interpreted more defensibly when calibration and uncertainty are evaluated together.
research_decision_spine: Uncertain feedback decisions -> routine summaries hide calibration -> structured evaluation -> clearer calibration anchor -> safer interpretation -> reader relevance.
journal_conversation: The fictional journal's readership is discussing trustworthy feedback design.
